# ECDLPResource17.ScalarProgram

**ScalarProgram**

实际曲线/子群、二进制scalarword及ECDLP Fourier解码的完整端点。

**边界**：实际双二进制word、经典预计算与源n+1位迭代计数。 PDF pp16–17. The actual word has2(n+1) controlled additions. Native ideal scalar correctness is separate from precomputation cost, approximate17-line execution and the Fourier measurement invariance proof. 已证实际cyclic-subgroup双binaryword输出、真实n+1位宽与2(n+1)slots；随机offset和实际bit错误/相干消费者在c004，完整Fourier invariance独立保留c019。

**覆盖等级**：B
